evaluation.quality_candidate: zg source-grounded pass and higher factual score or higher quality success than baseline; baseline may fail the unchanged quality contract.
evaluation.input_efficiency_candidate: Both source-grounded pass, zg factual score >= baseline, and zg reported complete input < baseline.
evaluation.resources: Report complete uncached+cache-read+cache-write input, agent time, and cold full slot time separately. No provider-billing inference; CLI budget is not billing attestation.
evaluation.candidate_meaning: Only a development observation from one pair. A stable effect requires separately frozen ten-per-profile confirmation excluding this development pair.
evaluation.outliers: No trimming for one repetition. A later repeat cohort must predeclare repeat-tail diagnostics, retain all raw trials/failures, and not treat repetitions as independent tasks for task-level MAD.
evaluation.failures: No replacement, retry, cherry picking, unknown-to-zero conversion or grading-contract relaxation.
